title: Shared definitions
description: Types the other schemas of the contract refer to as common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>.

time.description: an ISO 8601 time in UTC, as JavaScript's toISOString writes it

anyOf.description: an ISO 8601 time in UTC, as JavaScript's toISOString writes it

access_id.description: a Wayne State AccessID: two lower-case letters and four digits

folder.description: a folder under the lab storage's root as stored: parts of letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, each starting with a letter, a digit or an underscore, joined by /, 200 characters at most; "." is the whole volume and then the only folder

items.description: a folder under the lab storage's root as stored: parts of letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, each starting with a letter, a digit or an underscore, joined by /, 200 characters at most; "." is the whole volume and then the only folder

folders.description: one to eight folders, sorted, no repeats; ["."] for the whole volume

grants.description: what an approval gives: extension (Beethoven) and lab (lab membership); sorted, no repeats, not empty

page.description: a page of the website, for a person to open

signed_token.description: <prefix>.<base64url of the JSON payload>.<base64url of the Ed25519 signature over the ASCII text <prefix>.<payload part>> (lines.json, signed)
